page_map.1: Abstract, Introduction, Related Works; broad efficiency and quality claims
page_map.2: Method steps 1-5; TF-ISF, length, position and similarity equations (1)-(6); NSGA-II begins
page_map.3: NSGA-II equations (7)-(10), LM centroid equation (11), union/MMR equations (12)-(13), Performance Evaluation, Tables 1-3
page_map.4: CNN/DailyMail interpretation, two-stage ensemble Table 4, SciTLDR-AIC Tables 5-6
page_map.5: SciTLDR interpretation, Conclusion, References, author biographies

material_findings: The conference method is NSGA-II plus BERT/RoBERTa/XLNet top-10 candidate union followed by MMR, not the revised lexical-semantic-sparse-graph weighted-RRF architecture.
The conference experiments use CNN/DailyMail three-sentence outputs and SciTLDR-AIC one-sentence outputs; GovReport is absent.
Tables 1-6 do not provide paired confidence intervals or multiplicity-aware inference.
Runtime Tables 2-3 label microseconds while displayed cell values use milliseconds; the revised manuscript must not reuse those claims.
The conclusion presents NSGA-II/metaheuristics as quality-leading, which conflicts with the revised controlled evidence and must be explicitly superseded.
